title: The Glasshouse Run
description: Cross the formal garden, enter the glasshouse’s high interior, pass through maintenance tunnels, and leave along its roof.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery

signs.text:
The formal garden
Jump between the planted borders

The glasshouse entrance
Step up into the glass gallery

The palm-house canopy
Cross the broad galleries over the palms

The maintenance tunnels
Short jumps fit under the service beams

Along the rooftop beams
The last roof opens back into the garden
